about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Discovery Sport TD4 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Discovery Sport TD4 was offered from 2014 to 2019 as part of the first-generation L550 range. It uses the Ford Duratorq — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel shared across a range of Land Rover and Ford models of that era. The Duratorq was the diesel option of choice before the 2019 facelift, which replaced it with the Ingenium AJ200D family (D150/D180/D240). The TD4 is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ford Duratorq engines for every Discovery Sport TD4 on the road.
